command: cd validation && uv run python modes3/references.py
method: Analytic planar surface plasmon polariton (TM): beta = k0 sqrt(eps_m eps_d / (eps_m + eps_d)) from continuity of H_x and (1/eps) dH_x/dy; eps_m = (n + i kappa)^2 (exp(-i omega t)), eps_d = 1; kappaEff = Im n_spp.

targets.definition: power 1/e length lambda / (4 pi Im n_spp)

inputs.source: materials/gold.yaml n / kappa tables (Johnson and Christy 1972, refractiveindex.info Au/nk/Johnson.yml)
